name: krea
description: Image/video generation, architectural visualization, marketing creative, and developer integration patterns via the Krea CLI by default with MCP fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images and videos with Krea's full model lineup, plus vertical playbooks for archviz and marketing.
interface.longDescription: Krea AI Skills turn your agent into a Krea-native creative collaborator. Four skills layer together: krea-ai routes raw image and video generation through the Krea CLI by default, with MCP as fallback; krea-archviz adds architectural visualization workflows (3D-screenshot-to-render, materials, lighting, multi-image composition); krea-marketing covers product photography, video ads, brand-consistent batch generation, and click-to-ad pipelines; krea-build helps developers integrate Krea into their own applications.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image of a cyberpunk cat at golden hour
Render this Sketchup screenshot in photoreal evening light
Create a hero product shot of my new perfume bottle for the homepage
Help me integrate Krea image generation into my SvelteKit app
